title: Kidnapped to the Island
description: A star struck teenager is lured to a remote island by a controlling singer who promises her fame and fortune. Her mum, Michelle, must do everything in her power to save her daughter.

title: Ice Girls
description: A 15-year-old figure skating champion leaves the sport after her mother loses her job and the family moves to a small town. She struggles to fit in until the owner of a local skating arena helps her fulfil her true potential.

description: Miranda's 8-year-old daughter is kidnapped by Miranda's estranged father. As she chases him down, Miranda uncovers secrets from her childhood and discovers the father's true plans.

description: Convinced that he's found the man who abducted and sadistically abused him physically as a child, Steve Bryant is determined to get him to confess to what he did, by any means necessary.

description: Planning your life is not as simple as planning a party. Three sisters who make a living planning other people's parties are forced to realize that no matter how hard they try they can't control their own lives.

description: A newly engaged woman makes a wish that her fiancé takes the planning of their wedding seriously, and to her surprise and dismay, it comes true.
